title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 8

blocks.source_text: Well, it seems like our Ender Dragon has forgotten a thing or two about flying! In 26.4 Snapshot 8, we've fixed several issues with the dragon's flight behavior to help get it back on track. We've also added language support for two new languages, alongside a handful of smaller tweaks.
blocks.translated_text: 看来我们的末影龙在飞行方面忘掉了一些东西！在26.4版本的第8个快照中，我们修复了与末影龙飞行行为相关的一些问题，帮助它恢复正常。我们还为两种新语言添加了语言支持，并进行了一些小调整。

blocks.source_text: Happy Dragon Fighting!
blocks.translated_text: 祝大家龙战愉快！

blocks.source_text: New Features
blocks.translated_text: 新增功能

blocks.source_text: Added Javanese and Chavacano, Zamboanga language support to the game
blocks.translated_text: 游戏中新增了对爪哇语和查瓦卡诺语（Zamboanga）的支持

blocks.source_text: Changes
blocks.translated_text: 变更内容

blocks.source_text: Fixed some issues with the Ender Dragon battle that caused the dragon to not move properly
blocks.translated_text: 修复了末影龙战斗中导致龙无法正确移动的问题

blocks.source_text: Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities
blocks.translated_text: 对方块、物品和实体进行了一些小调整

blocks.source_text: Added Snow Layers and Snow Blocks next to the Snow Brick Set in the Creative Inventory
blocks.translated_text: 在创造模式的物品栏中，雪砖套装旁边新增了雪层和雪块

blocks.source_text: All undead mobs will now be immune to the Freezing effect
blocks.translated_text: 现在所有亡灵怪物都将对冰冻效果免疫

blocks.source_text: The damage dealt by the Ice Ball has been reduced
blocks.translated_text: 冰球造成的伤害已经降低了

blocks.source_text: The Cold Sulfur Cube archetype will no longer float to match the behavior of other archetypes of similar properties
blocks.translated_text: 冰属性的硫方怪原型将不再像其他具有类似属性的原型那样漂浮

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: 技术变更

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 127.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本现已更新为127.0

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 103.0
blocks.translated_text: 资源包版本现已更新为103.0

blocks.source_text: Terrain vertex data in terrain.vsh is now fetched from a texel buffer instead of traditional vertex buffers
blocks.translated_text: 地形文件（terrain.vsh）中的地形顶点数据现在从纹理缓冲区读取，而不是传统的顶点缓冲区

blocks.source_text: The packing of vertex data for terrain chunk section mesh data has been changed
blocks.translated_text: 地形区块部分网格数据的顶点数据打包方式已更改

blocks.source_text: Network Protocol
blocks.translated_text: 网络协议

blocks.source_text: The entity position synchronization packet now includes full-precision head rotation
blocks.translated_text: 实体位置同步数据包现在包含全精度头部旋转信息

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Versions 127.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本127.0的相关说明

blocks.source_text: Validation
blocks.translated_text: 验证流程

blocks.source_text: Most validation issues in following registries no longer prevent elements from being loaded:
blocks.translated_text: 以下注册表中的大多数验证问题不再阻止元素的加载：</text

blocks.source_text: minecraft:loot_table
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:loot_table

blocks.source_text: minecraft:predicate
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:predicate

blocks.source_text: minecraft:item_modifier
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:item_modifier

blocks.source_text: minecraft:slot_source
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:slot_source

blocks.source_text: minecraft:context_float_provider
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:context_float_provider

blocks.source_text: minecraft:context_int_provider
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:context_int_provider

blocks.source_text: minecraft:villager_trade
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:villager_trade

blocks.source_text: trigger fields in minecraft:advancement
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:advancement 中的触发字段

blocks.source_text: requirements fields on minecraft:enchantment_effect_component_type instances
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:enchantment_effect_component_type 实例上的要求字段

blocks.source_text: The following issues are now considered errors that can prevent pack loading or cause command compilation failure:
blocks.translated_text: 以下问题现在被视为可能导致资源包加载失败或命令编译失败的错误：

blocks.source_text: The validated element makes recursive calls to itself, either through tags or namespaced IDs
blocks.translated_text: 验证过的元素会通过标签或命名空间ID进行递归调用

blocks.source_text: Any context values required by the validated element are missing from the context provided during execution
blocks.translated_text: 在执行过程中，验证过的元素所需的任何上下文值都缺失

blocks.source_text: For example, the modifier type minecraft:apply_bonus (which uses the tool context value) cannot be used in an item ... modify command which provides the minecraft:command_modifier context (which lacks the tool context value)
blocks.translated_text: 例如，修改器类型 `minecraft:apply_bonus`（使用工具上下文值）不能用于 `item ... modify` 命令中，因为该命令提供的上下文是 `minecraft:command_modifier`（缺少工具上下文值）

blocks.source_text: Elements will only be validated if they don't have conditions or condition has all required context values
blocks.translated_text: 只有当元素没有任何条件，或者条件包含了所有必需的上下文值时，这些元素才会被验证

blocks.source_text: That means conditional elements can be used to avoid validation errors in loot elements used in multiple context
blocks.translated_text: 这意味着条件元素可以用来避免在多种上下文中使用的战利品元素出现验证错误

blocks.source_text: Conditional elements:
blocks.translated_text: 条件元素：

blocks.source_text: condition field for cases in minecraft:number_dispatcher (both minecraft:context_float_provider and minecraft:context_int_provider kinds)
blocks.translated_text: 在 Minecraft 中用于判断条件的字段：number_dispatcher（属于 minecraft:context_float_provider 和 minecraft:context_int_provider 类型）

blocks.source_text: merchant_predicate condition field in minecraft:villager_trade
blocks.translated_text: 用于商人（merchant）交易的谓词条件字段

blocks.source_text: condition field in loot pools, loot pool entries and loot functions
blocks.translated_text: 用于战利品池（loot pools）、战利品池条目（loot pool entries）和战利品函数（loot functions）的条件字段

blocks.source_text: Validation errors will now prevent command compilation, both in functions and from the console
blocks.translated_text: 现在，验证错误将阻止命令的编译，无论是在函数中还是在控制台中

blocks.source_text: For example, compute entity @s float {type: "minecraft:enchantment_level",amount:{type:"minecraft:linear",base:0.15,per_level_above_first:0.15}} will now fail to compile due to use of minecraft:enchantment_level in a minecraft:command_compute_entity context that does not provide required information ( minecraft:enchantment_level )
blocks.translated_text: 例如，尝试编译 `compute entity @s float {type: "minecraft:enchantment_level", amount: {type: "minecraft:linear", base: 0.15, per_level_above_first: 0.15}}` 会失败，因为在 minecraft:commandCompute_entity 的上下文中使用了 minecraft:enchantment_level，但该上下文没有提供所需的信息（即 minecraft:enchantment_level）

blocks.source_text: The minecraft:command context has been split into minecraft:command_predicate (used for predicates in commands, like /execute if predicate ) and minecraft:command_modifier (used for item modifiers, for example in /item ... modify functions)
blocks.translated_text: Minecraft的命令上下文已被拆分为`minecraft:commandpredicate`（用于命令中的条件，例如 `/execute if predicate`）和`minecraft:commandmodifier`（用于物品修改器，例如在 `/item ... modify`函数中）

blocks.source_text: To simplify the discovery of validation rules, a new report has been added: loot_context_requirements.json
blocks.translated_text: 为了简化验证规则的发现过程，新增了一个报告文件：`loot_context_requirements.json`

blocks.source_text: Values given as allowed for some context can be used by validated elements when run in this context
blocks.translated_text: 某些上下文中允许的数值可以在运行时被需要这些值的元素使用

blocks.source_text: The context used by command arguments can be found in the commands.json report in the context field of the following argument types:
blocks.translated_text: 命令参数所使用的上下文可以在`commands.json`报告的相应参数类型的`context`字段中找到

blocks.source_text: minecraft:context_float_provider
blocks.translated_text: `minecraft:context_float_provider`

blocks.source_text: minecraft:context_int_provider
blocks.translated_text: `minecraft:context_int_provider`

blocks.translated_text: `minecraft:loot_modifier`

blocks.translated_text: `minecraft:loot_table`

blocks.source_text: Commands
blocks.translated_text: 命令

blocks.source_text: The command report format has been changed:
blocks.translated_text: 命令报告的格式已经更改：

blocks.source_text: Argument information is now under the field argument instead of being merged into the parent node
blocks.translated_text: 参数信息现在位于“argument”字段中，而不是合并到父节点中

blocks.source_text: Information about suggestions is now available
blocks.translated_text: 关于建议的信息现已提供

blocks.source_text: Added pattern argument
blocks.translated_text: 添加了模式参数

blocks.source_text: Added command argument type for matching regular expression patterns
blocks.translated_text: 添加了用于匹配正则表达式模式的命令参数类型

blocks.source_text: This argument was added to improve support for commands added by server-side mods and plugins
blocks.translated_text: 添加此参数是为了更好地支持服务器端模组和插件添加的命令

blocks.source_text: Tags
blocks.translated_text: 标签

blocks.source_text: Block Tags
blocks.translated_text: 方块标签

blocks.translated_text: 添加了#triggers_ambient_ice_block_sounds - 所有触发“Ice”方块播放环境声音的方块

blocks.source_text: Added #triggers_ambient_ice_crystal_sounds - all blocks that trigger Ice Crystals to play their ambient sound
blocks.translated_text: 添加了 #triggers_ambient_ice_crystal_sounds – 使所有能够触发冰晶效果的方块都能播放其环境音效

blocks.source_text: Shaders & Post-process Effects
blocks.translated_text: 着色器与后处理效果（Shaders & Post-process Effects）

blocks.source_text: terrain.vsh is refactored to decode new vertex data packing
blocks.translated_text: terrain.vsh 已重构，以支持新的顶点数据打包格式

blocks.source_text: Order-Independent Transparency shaders
blocks.translated_text: 与绘制顺序无关的透明度着色器

blocks.source_text: OIT shaders were converted to rely on subpasses
blocks.translated_text: OIT着色器已转换为依赖子批次（subpasses）进行渲染

blocks.source_text: Changed core/oit_composite.fsh , core/oit_depth_bounds_cull.fsh , include/oit_depth_sample.glsl , include/oit_sample.glsl
blocks.translated_text: 修改了core/oit_composite.fsh、core/oit_depth_bounds_cull.fsh、include/oit_depth_sample.glsl和include/oit_sample.glsl文件

blocks.source_text: Added core/blit_depth_bounds.fsh shader to blit depth bounds in a subpass context
blocks.translated_text: 新增了core/blit_depth_bounds.fsh着色器，用于在子批次环境中绘制深度边界

blocks.source_text: Boat Water Mask Shaders
blocks.translated_text: 船用水面遮罩着色器

blocks.source_text: The way water mask is handled was changed to support subpasses in OIT
blocks.translated_text: 水面遮罩的处理方式已更改，以支持OIT（Optimized Image Transport）中的子批次渲染

blocks.source_text: It is now rendered to a separate target that is sampled during terrain rendering instead of being rendered to the terrain depth buffer
blocks.translated_text: 现在水面遮罩会被渲染到单独的目标缓冲区中，在地形渲染过程中对该缓冲区进行采样，而不是直接绘制到地形深度缓冲区

blocks.source_text: Changed core/rendertype_water_mask.fsh and core/terrain.fsh
blocks.translated_text: 修改了core/rendertype_water_mask.fsh和core/terrain.fsh文件

blocks.source_text: Removed core/blit_depth.fsh
blocks.translated_text: 移除了core/blit_depth.fsh文件

blocks.source_text: This approach is used both when OIT is on and off
blocks.translated_text: 无论OIT是否启用，都会使用这种处理方式

blocks.source_text: Fixed bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 8
blocks.translated_text: 修复了 26.4 快照 8 中的漏洞

blocks.source_text: [MC-164558](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-164558) - Mobs ridden by players very rarely receive vertical knockback when attacked
blocks.translated_text: [MC-164558](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-164558) - 被玩家骑乘的怪物在被攻击时极少会受到垂直方向的冲击

blocks.source_text: [MC-197201](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-197201) - Ender dragons no longer dive toward the player

blocks.source_text: [MC-271336](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-271336) - Ender dragons dive to the exit portal incorrectly

blocks.source_text: [MC-276058](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-276058) - The motion of some rideable entities stops when getting launched from wind charges

blocks.source_text: [MC-311382](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-311382) - The "Free trial" and "Try for free" buttons do not use high contrast button textures when the "High Contrast" resource pack is enabled

blocks.source_text: [MC-312077](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312077) - Some Realms progress screen strings are improperly capitalized, unlike similar strings

blocks.source_text: [MC-312762](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312762) - The closed caption for frostbites throwing ice balls is inconsistent with other mobs that throw projectiles

Well, it seems like our Ender Dragon has forgotten a thing or two about flying! In 26.4 Snapshot 8, we've fixed several issues with the dragon's flight behavior to help get it back on track. We've also added language support for two new languages, alongside a handful of smaller tweaks.

Happy Dragon Fighting!

New Features

Added Javanese and Chavacano, Zamboanga language support to the game

Changes

Fixed some issues with the Ender Dragon battle that caused the dragon to not move properly

Minor Tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

Added Snow Layers and Snow Blocks next to the Snow Brick Set in the Creative Inventory

All undead mobs will now be immune to the Freezing effect

The damage dealt by the Ice Ball has been reduced

The Cold Sulfur Cube archetype will no longer float to match the behavior of other archetypes of similar properties

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 127.0

The Resource Pack version is now 103.0

Terrain vertex data in terrain.vsh is now fetched from a texel buffer instead of traditional vertex buffers

The packing of vertex data for terrain chunk section mesh data has been changed

Network Protocol

The entity position synchronization packet now includes full-precision head rotation

Data Pack Versions 127.0

Validation

Most validation issues in following registries no longer prevent elements from being loaded:

minecraft:loot_table

minecraft:predicate

minecraft:item_modifier

minecraft:slot_source

minecraft:context_float_provider

minecraft:context_int_provider

minecraft:villager_trade

trigger fields in minecraft:advancement

requirements fields on minecraft:enchantment_effect_component_type instances

The following issues are now considered errors that can prevent pack loading or cause command compilation failure:

The validated element makes recursive calls to itself, either through tags or namespaced IDs

Any context values required by the validated element are missing from the context provided during execution

For example, the modifier type minecraft:apply_bonus (which uses the tool context value) cannot be used in an item ... modify command which provides the minecraft:command_modifier context (which lacks the tool context value)

Elements will only be validated if they don't have conditions or condition has all required context values

That means conditional elements can be used to avoid validation errors in loot elements used in multiple context

Conditional elements:

condition field for cases in minecraft:number_dispatcher (both minecraft:context_float_provider and minecraft:context_int_provider kinds)

merchant_predicate condition field in minecraft:villager_trade

condition field in loot pools, loot pool entries and loot functions

Validation errors will now prevent command compilation, both in functions and from the console

For example, compute entity @s float {type: "minecraft:enchantment_level",amount:{type:"minecraft:linear",base:0.15,per_level_above_first:0.15}} will now fail to compile due to use of minecraft:enchantment_level in a minecraft:command_compute_entity context that does not provide required information ( minecraft:enchantment_level )

The minecraft:command context has been split into minecraft:command_predicate (used for predicates in commands, like /execute if predicate ) and minecraft:command_modifier (used for item modifiers, for example in /item ... modify functions)

To simplify the discovery of validation rules, a new report has been added: loot_context_requirements.json

Values given as allowed for some context can be used by validated elements when run in this context

The context used by command arguments can be found in the commands.json report in the context field of the following argument types:

minecraft:context_float_provider

minecraft:context_int_provider

minecraft:loot_modifier

minecraft:loot_predicate

minecraft:loot_table

minecraft:slot_source

Commands

The command report format has been changed:

Argument information is now under the field argument instead of being merged into the parent node

Information about suggestions is now available

Added pattern argument

Added command argument type for matching regular expression patterns

This argument was added to improve support for commands added by server-side mods and plugins

Tags

Block Tags

Added #triggers_ambient_ice_block_sounds - all blocks that trigger Ice to play its ambient sound

Added #triggers_ambient_ice_crystal_sounds - all blocks that trigger Ice Crystals to play their ambient sound

Resource Pack Versions 103.0

UI Sprites

Added a new UI texture:

friends/tab_focused.png

Sounds

Added new sound events:

entity.frostbite.throw

Shaders & Post-process Effects

terrain.vsh is refactored to decode new vertex data packing

Order-Independent Transparency shaders

OIT shaders were converted to rely on subpasses

Changed core/oit_composite.fsh , core/oit_depth_bounds_cull.fsh , include/oit_depth_sample.glsl , include/oit_sample.glsl

Added core/blit_depth_bounds.fsh shader to blit depth bounds in a subpass context

Boat Water Mask Shaders

The way water mask is handled was changed to support subpasses in OIT

It is now rendered to a separate target that is sampled during terrain rendering instead of being rendered to the terrain depth buffer

Changed core/rendertype_water_mask.fsh and core/terrain.fsh

Removed core/blit_depth.fsh

This approach is used both when OIT is on and off

Fixed bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 8

[MC-313046](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-313046) - Item tooltips in inventories now appear too low or too high

[MC-313052](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-313052) - The game crashes when pressing an arrow key after pressing a mouse button other than left-click over an entry in the items tab of the statistics menu

[MC-313053](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-313053) - Failed /effect commands report applying zero effects instead of specifying the appropriate value

Get the Snapshot

看来我们的末影龙在飞行方面忘掉了一些东西！在26.4版本的第8个快照中，我们修复了与末影龙飞行行为相关的一些问题，帮助它恢复正常。我们还为两种新语言添加了语言支持，并进行了一些小调整。

祝大家龙战愉快！

新增功能

游戏中新增了对爪哇语和查瓦卡诺语（Zamboanga）的支持

变更内容

修复了末影龙战斗中导致龙无法正确移动的问题

对方块、物品和实体进行了一些小调整

在创造模式的物品栏中，雪砖套装旁边新增了雪层和雪块

现在所有亡灵怪物都将对冰冻效果免疫

冰球造成的伤害已经降低了

冰属性的硫方怪原型将不再像其他具有类似属性的原型那样漂浮

技术变更

数据包版本现已更新为127.0

资源包版本现已更新为103.0

地形文件（terrain.vsh）中的地形顶点数据现在从纹理缓冲区读取，而不是传统的顶点缓冲区

地形区块部分网格数据的顶点数据打包方式已更改

网络协议

实体位置同步数据包现在包含全精度头部旋转信息

数据包版本127.0的相关说明

验证流程

以下注册表中的大多数验证问题不再阻止元素的加载：</text

minecraft:loot_table

minecraft:predicate

minecraft:item_modifier

minecraft:slot_source

minecraft:context_float_provider

minecraft:context_int_provider

minecraft:villager_trade

minecraft:advancement 中的触发字段

minecraft:enchantment_effect_component_type 实例上的要求字段

以下问题现在被视为可能导致资源包加载失败或命令编译失败的错误：

验证过的元素会通过标签或命名空间ID进行递归调用

在执行过程中，验证过的元素所需的任何上下文值都缺失

例如，修改器类型 `minecraft:apply_bonus`（使用工具上下文值）不能用于 `item ... modify` 命令中，因为该命令提供的上下文是 `minecraft:command_modifier`（缺少工具上下文值）

只有当元素没有任何条件，或者条件包含了所有必需的上下文值时，这些元素才会被验证

这意味着条件元素可以用来避免在多种上下文中使用的战利品元素出现验证错误

条件元素：

在 Minecraft 中用于判断条件的字段：number_dispatcher（属于 minecraft:context_float_provider 和 minecraft:context_int_provider 类型）

用于商人（merchant）交易的谓词条件字段

用于战利品池（loot pools）、战利品池条目（loot pool entries）和战利品函数（loot functions）的条件字段

现在，验证错误将阻止命令的编译，无论是在函数中还是在控制台中

例如，尝试编译 `compute entity @s float {type: "minecraft:enchantment_level", amount: {type: "minecraft:linear", base: 0.15, per_level_above_first: 0.15}}` 会失败，因为在 minecraft:commandCompute_entity 的上下文中使用了 minecraft:enchantment_level，但该上下文没有提供所需的信息（即 minecraft:enchantment_level）

Minecraft的命令上下文已被拆分为`minecraft:commandpredicate`（用于命令中的条件，例如 `/execute if predicate`）和`minecraft:commandmodifier`（用于物品修改器，例如在 `/item ... modify`函数中）

为了简化验证规则的发现过程，新增了一个报告文件：`loot_context_requirements.json`

某些上下文中允许的数值可以在运行时被需要这些值的元素使用

命令参数所使用的上下文可以在`commands.json`报告的相应参数类型的`context`字段中找到

`minecraft:context_float_provider`

`minecraft:context_int_provider`

`minecraft:loot_modifier`

`minecraft:loot_predicate`

`minecraft:loot_table`

`minecraft:slot_source`

命令

命令报告的格式已经更改：

参数信息现在位于“argument”字段中，而不是合并到父节点中

关于建议的信息现已提供

添加了模式参数

添加了用于匹配正则表达式模式的命令参数类型

添加此参数是为了更好地支持服务器端模组和插件添加的命令

标签

方块标签

添加了#triggers_ambient_ice_block_sounds - 所有触发“Ice”方块播放环境声音的方块

添加了 #triggers_ambient_ice_crystal_sounds – 使所有能够触发冰晶效果的方块都能播放其环境音效

资源包版本 103.0

用户界面精灵（UI Sprites）

添加了一种新的用户界面纹理

friends/tab_focused.png

音效（Sounds）

添加了新的音效事件

entity.frostbite.throw

着色器与后处理效果（Shaders & Post-process Effects）

terrain.vsh 已重构，以支持新的顶点数据打包格式

与绘制顺序无关的透明度着色器

OIT着色器已转换为依赖子批次（subpasses）进行渲染

修改了core/oit_composite.fsh、core/oit_depth_bounds_cull.fsh、include/oit_depth_sample.glsl和include/oit_sample.glsl文件

新增了core/blit_depth_bounds.fsh着色器，用于在子批次环境中绘制深度边界

船用水面遮罩着色器

水面遮罩的处理方式已更改，以支持OIT（Optimized Image Transport）中的子批次渲染

现在水面遮罩会被渲染到单独的目标缓冲区中，在地形渲染过程中对该缓冲区进行采样，而不是直接绘制到地形深度缓冲区

修改了core/rendertype_water_mask.fsh和core/terrain.fsh文件

移除了core/blit_depth.fsh文件

无论OIT是否启用，都会使用这种处理方式

修复了 26.4 快照 8 中的漏洞

[MC-164558](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-164558) - 被玩家骑乘的怪物在被攻击时极少会受到垂直方向的冲击
